sophia (People Ops): Quick check-in: rolling reminder that the review window closes end-of-day Friday 11:59pm PT. A few notes below about contractors, timezone weirdness, and bulk uploads.

derek (Eng Manager): Thanks. Is there a special rule for contractors who started mid-cycle? One of mine started 45 days ago.

sophia (People Ops): Contractors: if contract start <= 30 days before cycle end, mark as "Not Eligible" and add a short note. For 31-90 days we allow a concise manager summary in place of a full self-assessment. Please flag contractors in the "Worker Type" field so payroll/audit tags correctly.

rana (IC): FYI timezone confusion: my manager and I are in different zones (EU vs PT) and the UI shows Fri as Sat for me. Does the system respect local timezone or org timezone?

sophia (People Ops): System uses PT as canonical cutoff. So submit by your local midnight if that maps before PT cutoff. If you're blocked by timezones, use the timezone extension option on the extension form and note local deadline — we won't penalize.

mike (Hiring Ops): Two quick ops items: 1) We added a bulk upload API for managers who have many direct reports (useful for ICs in Product). 2) Hiring Ops needs visibility into hires with extension granted — add tag "ext-granted" in Manager Notes so we can sync offers/comp cycles. API docs: https://redwood.example.com/api/reviews/bulk-upload

derek (Eng Manager): Bulk upload — is there a template?

mike (Hiring Ops): Yes: CSV template on the docs page. Required columns: email, manager_email, status, comment. The system validates and returns a per-row result. Example: 
```
email,manager_email,status,comment
rana@redwood.com,derek@redwood.com,submitted,"uploaded on behalf, verbal OK"
```

sophia (People Ops): Note on calibration fairness: if you're a calibrator and have a conflict (close skip-level), please recuse using the "recuse" button in the calibration UI. Recusal triggers an alternate calibrator assignment.

rana (IC): Will peer feedback be included in the packet after calibration? I left some 1:1 notes in my manager's doc.

sophia (People Ops): Peer feedback field is optional but if your manager includes peer notes in the review packet, yes it will be included in the final packet. If you prefer to keep drafts private until after calibration, tell your manager to leave them out of the packet.

hr-bot: :lock: Audit log reminder: any edits to submitted reviews will create an audit entry with actor and timestamp.

derek (Eng Manager): Can managers correct typos after submission? Tiny errors only.

sophia (People Ops): Small edits allowed within 48 hours after submission; after calibration locks, changes require a change request form. We track all edits in the audit log (see Console > Reviews > Audit).

mike (Hiring Ops): We're also tracking promotion-candidate flags. Managers: if you flag someone for promotion, please add the "promo-candidate" label and include a 2-3 sentence rationale — this helps the Promotions committee triage.

rana (IC): If someone is OOO and misses manager signature, what's the fallback?

sophia (People Ops): If employee is OOO, manager can still sign off after documenting attempt to reach them. If manager sign-off can't be obtained due to prolonged absence, route to People Ops (reviews@redwood.com) with notes and we'll follow the exception flow.

derek (Eng Manager): One more: where's the one-click summary export for employees?

sophia (People Ops): On by default: Console > Reviews > My Reviews > Export Summary. If anyone hits permission errors, ping me and we'll patch ACLs.

hr-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder sent to all participants who haven't submitted yet.

sophia (People Ops): Last-minute office hours: Fri 09:00-10:30 PT and Fri 16:00-17:00 PT. Use drop-in: https://cal.redwood.com/reviews-quickhelp. If you need a manual PDF of your packet, request via reviews@redwood.com and include your manager.

derek (Eng Manager): Thanks team. I'll use the bulk upload for my group and flag two promo candidates.

sophia (People Ops): Appreciate it — ping us for any hiccups. Good luck! :sparkles:
